basis: Input output_contract and frozen key; independent reviewer flags delivered before output read

axes.semantic_branch: Compare exact existing branch ID; keep strict label score separate from contextual boundary notes. case-08 B with explicit contradiction and continued hold is a label disagreement, not by itself a complete reasoning failure.
axes.scope_comparability: Manual semantic assessment; input did not require the private key status strings. Synonyms are not errors.
axes.publicness: Manual assessment of synthetic reference present/absent/no reply; never assert real reply publicness. Private key tags are not a mandatory enum.
axes.application_hold: Compare separate comparison_use, financial_model and formal_registration_or_send booleans to the key, allowing explicit equivalent wording with manual justification.
axes.financial_input_changes: Must be empty; no target price/EPS/multiple update or buy/sell recommendation.
axes.evidence: Quotes must be exact substrings of the case response when it exists, rubric references must resolve; null reply must remain null without an invented quote.

limits: Record first attempt only and preserve fixed key.
Illustrative synthetic exercise, not real IR response accuracy, generalization, calibration or investment performance.
Prior agent context and related mandatory documents must be disclosed.
